row.evidence: Bynder's pricing page says its modular plans are customized and quote-only ('Get a quote'), with Single Sign-on in all packages; its help centre says 'Bynder supports SCIM functionality, including creating, updating and deactivating user accounts with Azure' (and Okta).
row.notes: GatherContent now redirects to Bynder Content Workflow; Content Workflow is enabled as a Bynder module (contact Customer Success, 'any associated costs') and its users come from Bynder permission profiles, so the row covers the Bynder portal. The Stand Alone Content Workflow plan has its own SAML SSO ('may not be available in your current plan') and no documented SCIM. Bynder has no public tiers or prices; every package is a custom quote, so SCIM is only obtainable through sales. The June '~$450/mo starter (500 GB)' price and 'Small Business' plan name had no first-party source and were dropped; scim_plan 'Enterprise' also dropped (no tier names published). SCIM works with Entra (bearer permanent token, non-gallery app) and Okta (OAuth2, custom app integration); not partial. SCIM needs SSO and only manages SSO users; deprovisioning deactivates, no deletion, no group/profile mapping.

plans.name: Custom package
plans.notes: Bynder publishes no tiers; all packages include Single Sign-on and API access ('APIs').

auth.token_source: Entra: Advanced Settings > Portal Settings > Permanent tokens (integration 'SCIM -> Entra ID (Azure AD)'), used as bearer token. Okta: Advanced Settings > Portal Settings > OAuth Apps (integration 'SCIM: Okta'), OAuth2.
auth.notes: Bearer permanent token for Entra; OAuth2 client for Okta.

operations.notes: Docs list create, update and deactivate; permanent deletion is not supported via SCIM; group/profile mapping is not possible through SCIM. Reactivation is blocked for users deactivated less than 180 days.

deprovision.data_retained: User is deactivated, not deleted; permanent deletion only in Bynder User Management UI.

roles.how: Not via SCIM; new SCIM users get the default permission profile, and SSO JIT profile/group mappings apply on next login.

limitations.text: SCIM creates only SSO users; SSO must already be configured.
Only username, email, first name, last name and active status sync; group and profile mapping is not supported.
Entra's Bynder gallery app does not support SCIM; a non-gallery custom app is required.
Changing a username in Okta creates a new Bynder user.
Users deactivated less than 180 days ago cannot be reactivated through SCIM.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'bynder' returns no results; Bynder's guide uses a custom Okta app integration with SCIM provisioning.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO (with JIT); SCIM needs a non-gallery custom app pointing at the generic endpoint.

google.notes: Google SSO login method is supported; no Google catalogue provisioning found.
